review.item_premise: Public values remain structured through the queue, with bounded byte charge and loss causes. Artifact chunks bound JSON nesting. Exit reports delivered, lost and undelivered records synchronously after its byte-scaled drain deadline. These delivery changes do not affect results or secret exposure. The authorized HOST dispatch selects its own storage stem; host-owner-accounting checks it independently of the other owners. The authorized WALLET dispatch selects its own devnet stem; wallet-owner-accounting checks default and trace counters and duration independently of the other owners. The GRAPH dispatch selects its own graph stem; graph_owner_accounting checks default and trace counters and duration independently of the other owners. The EPOCH dispatch selects its own compiler stem; epoch_owner_accounting independently checks its default and trace counters and duration. Adding the act-profile owner or optional opaque commitment carrier preserves prior arguments and outcomes; the complete new field remains public evidence. The shared credential operations preserve private representations and use the registered public accounting owner; host transport and limiter remain in their existing boundary.
